decision.thesis: Account flat, 5000.04174826 USDT wallet, no position, no open orders, NOTHING TO RECONCILE - no exit order has ever been placed in this experiment. Decision no_trade because THE TRADABLE SET IS EMPTY. HEADLINE: THIS IS THE FIRST CHECK OF THE EXPERIMENT AT WHICH THE EVIDENCE GATE WOULD PASS AND THE TRADE IS REFUSED ANYWAY. The daily review ran after the 22:00 check and RULED on the question the 21:00 and 22:00 checks referred to it: LESSONS.md now carries a standing note that ALL FIVE watchlist contracts are excluded under L-001 and that 'the tradable set is empty ... A check may not resolve it by reinterpreting a frame, re-dating a print or widening the watchlist; it records the state and returns no_trade.' ETHUSDT was caught by L-001's third amendment on its 2850.00 print. That ruling binds here, and it binds against an ETHUSDT SHORT that offers THREE independent evidence categories - trend, price_action and volume - all pointing the same way. Under any earlier state of the watchlist this would have been the first check to reach the pricing stage with the gate satisfied. It is refused twice over: (1) L-001 excludes ETHUSDT and a check may never retire or loosen a lesson even when a re-test condition is met; (2) L-005 independently refused EVERY contract including ETHUSDT, which went unquoted on its ask at sweep 5. NO CONSTRUCTION WAS PRICED ON ETHUSDT. Pricing a stop and target on an excluded contract is exactly the 'looking for a construction' the 22:00 note warned against, and L-004 requires the span screen before any ratio - but a screen run on an excluded contract is work done to make an impossible trade look close. The required span is recorded as a fact (2.5N + 0.14% = 2.335%) and no entry, stop or target was built. WHAT CHANGED SINCE 22:00 - THE BREAKOUT FAILED. At 22:00 the 2660.00 floor (9 touches) had held five times and the 1h 13:00Z bar had CLOSED at 2668.42 through the 2670.98 hour high, so price_action supported a LONG. Since then: 14:25Z ran O2674.61 H2694.37 C2693.53 on V253,078 (+0.74% in one bar); 2694.37 was never exceeded; 14:45Z reversed O2680.59 C2664.41 on V257,646 (1.97x median); 14:50Z printed L2655.35 C2658.29 on V376,794 (2.89x median, THE LARGEST BAR OF THE WINDOW); 14:55Z and 15:00Z both made L2655.22. The 1h 14:00Z bar CLOSED at 2659.74, BELOW the 13:00Z close of 2668.42, so the higher-high/higher-low sequence is broken ON A CLOSED BAR, and the 2660.00 floor is now overhead resistance. THE EVIDENCE GATE THEREFORE PASSES SHORT ON THREE CATEGORIES: trend DOWN (4h highs 2695.84 -> 2690.73 -> 2698.06 -> 2693.42 -> 2694.37; 4h lows 2668.06 -> 2666.20 -> 2669.37 -> 2633.31 -> 2640.00; daily closes 2775.61 -> 2752.43 -> 2684.16); price_action a FAILED BREAKOUT, which is the strategy's own named pattern; and volume CONFIRMING THE DOWN MOVE for the first time - the reversal bars traded 1.97x and 2.89x the 130,556 median and the 14:00Z hour traded 2,440,698, the heaviest hour of the day, the exact opposite of 22:00 where the bar that made the high traded BELOW median. derivatives NOT claimed (ETH still clamped at exactly +0.010000%, OI flat at +0.019%). market_context NOT claimed on independence: 24h BTC -0.997%, ETH -0.633%, BNB +1.402%, SOL -0.538%, XRP -1.975% - ETH is the SECOND STRONGEST of the five and BNB is POSITIVE, so nothing here asserts ETH weakness. news recorded, not claimed, a reason against. THE 14:25Z SPIKE IS CROSS-CONTRACT CONFIRMED, THE OPPOSITE OF THE 13:35Z FINDING, AND THIS IS RECORDED AGAINST INTEREST: all five contracts moved together up and then back down (ETH 14:25Z 5.77x its 5m median then 4.03x/3.17x; BTC 14:30Z 4.59x then 14:50Z 7.01x; SOL 14:25Z 3.61x then 3.62x; XRP 14:30Z 3.38x then 14:50Z 5.29x; BNB 14:45Z 3.77x). So 2694.37 is a USABLE level and is NOT an artifact - the isolation test is capable of clearing a print and here it did. The 13:35Z isolation finding is unchanged, so 2671.94 REMAINS EXCLUDED as a level; it is moot in any case now that price has traded above it and back through it. L-007: THE 22:00 FORECAST'S CONDITION DID NOT HOLD. The 22:00 note wrote that N would be 0.468% until ~14:35Z and then, IF THE NEXT HOUR WAS QUIET, would collapse toward ~0.13% and make the 0.26x/0.53x stops refused there read 1.0x-1.9x on identical structure. The hour was NOT quiet: the 13:35Z bar left the 1h window as forecast but a FAR LARGER impulse printed at 14:25Z (0.878%, 5.77x the 5m median), the bar that created the 2694.37 high any short would now be fading. N(hour) = N(2h) = N(3h) = N(5h) = 0.878%. N DID NOT COLLAPSE TO ~0.13%; IT VERY NEARLY DOUBLED, 0.468% -> 0.878%, and the required span rose 1.310%/1.513% -> 2.335%. THE SCREEN GOT HARDER, NOT EASIER. Second consecutive check at which the conditional's 'new impulse bar' branch fired rather than the quiet-collapse branch, and third consecutive check at which a written forecast correctly told its successor which measurement to make first. Recorded honestly: the POINT VALUE was not reached because the CONDITION did not hold; whether that advances or resets any clock is THE REVIEW'S CALL, NOT THIS CHECK'S. No lesson was loosened, reinterpreted, retired or overridden; no rule or risk limit was relaxed.

All five watchlist contracts are excluded on re-verified UNREVISED higher-frame artifacts, and LESSONS.md's standing note - written by the daily review after the 22:00 check - states that the tradable set is empty and that a check may not resolve it by reinterpreting a frame, re-dating a print or widening the watchlist, but records the state and returns no_trade. ETHUSDT's ASK FELL TO 500.40 USDT AT s5 - 5x below a single maximum order - AFTER FOUR CONSECUTIVE HEALTHY SAMPLES, with its bid at 9,998.50 in the same sweep, ending its two-check pass exactly as the 22:00 note warned it might. lessons_applied: L-001 - applied at 5m/1h/4h/daily PLUS the cross-contract test, and it is THE BINDING CONSTRAINT OF THIS CHECK. All five prints re-verified UNREVISED this check: BTCUSDT 09-21 08:00Z 4h H95,804.10 at 18.19x median range and a 13.546% wick on a 3.846% body (plus 09-21 12:00Z 13.66x, 09-21 16:00Z 6.48x, 09-21 20:00Z w/b 58.0, 09-21 daily 18.161% = 7.93x) - a 24TH consecutive check; SOLUSDT 09-22 16:00Z 4h L106.67 at 11.175% range = 6.82x with a 9.975% lower wick on a 0.712% body = 14.0x, 09-22 daily w/b 28.8, and a ~270x quote-volume shortfall - a 14TH; XRPUSDT 09-23 04:00Z 4h H1.6855 at w/b 33.9 and 2.24x median range; BNBUSDT 09-24 00:00Z 4h H780.90 at w/b 16.0, unchanged across four checks; ETHUSDT 09-21 08:00Z 4h H2850.00 at 5.51x median range, still inside the 30-bar 4h window. THE REVIEW'S RULING ON ETH IS APPLIED IN FULL AND IS NOT REINTERPRETED. RECORDED AGAINST INTEREST AND REFERRED TO THE REVIEW: my own daily scan again finds ETHUSDT has NO FLAG ON THE 09-21 DAILY BAR AT ALL - its only daily flags in the 30-bar window are 09-11 (3.15x), 08-27, 09-20 and 09-08 - whereas LESSONS L-001 cites 'the 09-21 08:00Z 4h bar AND the 09-21 daily bar'. THE 4h HALF OF THAT CITATION IS CONFIRMED EXACTLY; THE DAILY HALF IS NOT REPRODUCIBLE FROM THIS HOST'S DATA. The review recorded the full counter-argument itself (w/b only 2.0, an order of magnitude below every other caught print; 7.2% above the market; contaminates no field priced here) and excluded ETH anyway on the grounds that ruling the other way would be a loosening made on four days of data and zero trades. That ruling stands and the exclusion binds; the discrepancy is recorded for the only body that may act on it. SEPARATELY, THE ISOLATION TEST WAS RE-RUN AS THE 22:00 NOTE DIRECTED AND IT CLEARED A PRINT FOR THE FIRST TIME: the new 14:25Z impulse is CROSS-CONTRACT CONFIRMED on all five contracts (ETH 5.77x its 5m median, BTC 14:30Z 4.59x, SOL 14:25Z 3.61x, XRP 14:30Z 3.38x; and the 14:45Z-14:50Z reversal equally market-wide at BTC 7.01x, XRP 5.29x, BNB 3.77x, SOL 3.62x), so 2694.37 IS A USABLE LEVEL AND IS NOT AN ARTIFACT. The 13:35Z finding is unchanged, so 2671.94 REMAINS EXCLUDED as a level - moot now that price has traded above it and back through it.

L-002 - applied. N measured over FULL windows, never a convenient recent one: N(hour, 12 closed) = N(2h) = N(3h) = N(5h) = 0.878%, all defined by the 14:25Z bar, which is the bar that CREATED the 2694.37 high any short would now be fading. TALLY NOT ADVANCED AND COULD NOT BE: no construction was priced on an excluded contract, so no stop distance was measured against N and nothing could resolve a declined setup in either direction. The two 09-23 23:00 BNBUSDT constructions remain live and unresolved; the tally stands at ONE OF THREE.

L-003 - applied: FIVE BOOK SWEEPS were taken across 15:05:08Z-15:07:49Z, satisfying the requote discipline. NO RATIO EXISTED TO REQUOTE, because no construction was built on an excluded contract. CLOCK STAYS AT ZERO.

L-004 - applied FIRST, before any reward/risk was computed, AND APPLIED AS A REFUSAL TO COMPUTE. The required span is recorded as a fact: 2.5N + 0.14% = 2.335% on N = 0.878%, UP from the 1.310% long / 1.513% short of the 22:00 check because N nearly doubled. NO ENTRY, STOP OR TARGET WAS CONSTRUCTED. Running the span screen on a contract L-001 excludes is work done to make an impossible trade look close, and the 22:00 note's own instruction was 'do not go looking for a construction'. The screen is recorded, not exercised.

L-005 - applied with FIVE SWEEPS against the 2,500 USDT maximum order notional, a FIFTEENTH CONSECUTIVE CHECK IN WHICH THE 25 bps CAP WAS BLIND TO THE ENTIRE FINDING, and this check produced THE FIRST FULLY SYNCHRONISED BOOK FAILURE OF THE EXPERIMENT: at s5, 15:07:49Z, ALL FIVE CONTRACTS WERE SIMULTANEOUSLY UNQUOTED ON AT LEAST ONE SIDE. ETHUSDT's ask fell to 500.40 USDT after FOUR consecutive healthy samples (bid 213,668 / 683,733 / 4,923,874 / 3,298,860, ask 452,208 / 3,136,638 / 1,381,263 / 3,303,248), ending its two-check pass - the 22:00 note predicted precisely this and wrote that ETH's first pass 'PROVES NOTHING ABOUT NEXT CHECK'. It proved nothing. BNBUSDT's bid was below a maximum order on FOUR OF FIVE sweeps (887.08, 513.57, 202.44, 31.14), the worst sustained reading of the experiment, with 31.14 USDT quoting 2.183 bps. SOLUSDT failed on BOTH sides at s4 and s5, its ask reading 10.32 then 5.74 USDT. XRPUSDT's bid printed 58.02, 24.00 and 27.16 USDT - a FIFTH consecutive check with an XRP bid collapse. BTCUSDT's ask was unquoted on three of five sweeps. The widest spread of the entire check was 19.175 bps (SOL, s5) and the 5.74 USDT SOL ask sat INSIDE it; BTC's 18.601 bps at s3 also passed the cap. A reduce-only stop resting on this book between checks cannot be assumed to fill near its trigger - which is what P-009 asks Edward for an engine-side rule about.

L-006 - applied to EVERY window-derived figure, FOUR INSTANCES, TWO AGAINST INTEREST. (a) ETHUSDT high24h fell 2717.26 -> 2698.06 with no revision anywhere - a bar leaving the 24h window, not a market event; nothing was priced against it. (b) AGAINST INTEREST: ETHUSDT low24h is STILL 2633.31, UNCHANGED, so a short's 24h-low target WOULD survive re-measurement against the setup-containing window. (c) AGAINST INTEREST: the 14:25Z move SURVIVES the isolation test as a genuine market-wide event, which is why price_action was recorded as having genuinely flipped rather than dismissed as arithmetic - the 1h 14:00Z bar CLOSED at 2659.74, a closed-bar fact. (d) BNBUSDT high24h ROSE 781.60 -> 783.34, and this one is a GENUINE MARKET EVENT: a real new print in the 14:00Z 1h bar (H783.34) that EXCEEDS the artifact. So 780.90 stopped contaminating the 24h high field by BEING EXCEEDED, not by being corrected and not by ageing out - a THIRD distinct mechanism in three checks to move a BNB field while the print itself stands unrevised at w/b 16.0 on the 4h. This is exactly the flicker the 22:00 note warned would be misread as the contract becoming readable, and BNB STAYS EXCLUDED. Separately, L-006 is why the 12:00Z 4h close test was NOT evaluated: that bar does not close until 16:00Z = 00:00 LOCAL and reads C2660.68 forming, now 5.5 points FURTHER from the 2666.20 threshold than at 22:00; reading a forming bar as closed is the exact hazard this lesson names. CLOCK STAYS AT ZERO.

L-007 - applied, and the forecast is reported honestly INCLUDING ITS MISS. The 22:00 note named the window, the bar and the direction: 'N WILL BE 0.468% UNTIL ~14:35Z AND THEN DEPENDS ENTIRELY ON WHAT PRINTS. If the next hour is quiet, N will collapse toward ~0.13% and the 0.26x/0.53x stops refused here will read 1.0x-1.9x on IDENTICAL STRUCTURE.' THE ANTECEDENT WAS FALSE - THE HOUR WAS NOT QUIET. The 13:35Z bar did leave the 1h window at 14:35Z as forecast, but a FAR LARGER impulse printed at 14:25Z (0.878%, 5.77x the 5m median), and it is the bar that created the 2694.37 high. N DID NOT COLLAPSE TO ~0.13%; IT VERY NEARLY DOUBLED, 0.468% -> 0.878%, and the required span rose from 1.310%/1.513% to 2.335%. THE SCREEN GOT HARDER, NOT EASIER - which is the one direction the lesson says a rolling window almost never delivers. This is the SECOND CONSECUTIVE CHECK at which the conditional's 'new impulse bar' branch fired rather than the quiet-collapse branch, and the THIRD CONSECUTIVE CHECK at which a written forecast correctly told its successor which measurement to make first. THE POINT VALUE WAS NOT REACHED BECAUSE THE CONDITION DID NOT HOLD; whether that advances, resets or leaves L-007's clock is THE REVIEW'S CALL, NOT THIS CHECK'S, and it is stated rather than scored.
